Needs changes before merge. Set `needs-rework` for the three evidence defects below.

What is good:

- The change adds research notes only. It changes no executable code, machine file, UI, test fixture or recorded NC program.
- The notes give source URLs and distinguish many unknown results from confirmed facts. `Refs #4095` correctly keeps the implementation issue open.

Local checks:

- Reviewed all seven added files against the current `upstream/main` rules at `5b52c5f8ca0a03e8b71af0453056b920b5d9e742`.
- The PR already contains that main commit. The local trial-merge record has the PR head as its first parent and main as its second parent. Its tree is unchanged from the PR head.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed; no applicable test steps.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed; 0 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. The local gate tool built successfully. No product build, test suite or clippy run was needed for these Markdown files.
- Extra suites run: none. No importer, fixture, post, operation, motion or catalog file changed. Light and heavy suites were not run for this document-only change.
- Mutations: not applicable. The PR changes no posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, gouge check or collision check. Goldens moved: none.
- Source checks: downloaded the cited manuals 1096959-20, 53318820 and 34594022 to a temporary directory and checked their relevant pages. No runner was used.

Requested before merge:

1. **Incorrect capability profiles — `docs/research/heidenhain/dialects.md:83`.** The TNC 320 profile says cycle 205 gets Q208/Q395 at `77185x-05`. Manual [1096959-20](https://content.heidenhain.de/doku/tnc_guide/pdf_files/TNC320/771851-01/zyklen/1096959-20.pdf), PDF page 9, places both additions at `77185x-01`; page 82 includes both parameters. Section B3 also lists them at -01. The wrong threshold occurs again in README finding 3, the B2 cycle-205 row and the cycle-205 name table. There is another profile mismatch at `dialects.md:76`: M140 is false for all 280472-477, while `differences-by-version.md:140` records its addition at 280476. A resolver made from these profiles would refuse supported functions or select a different retract form. Check every profile value against its cited source. Correct all copies of each threshold together, and mark a value unknown when the evidence is incomplete.

2. **Q lists include a different cycle — `docs/research/heidenhain/differences.md:198`.** The row for cycle 200 on iTNC 34049x-01 contains Q216/Q217/Q244/Q245/Q246/Q247/Q241/Q365. These are not that drilling cycle's parameters. The cited ISO manual [53318820](https://content.heidenhain.de/doku/tnc_guide/pdf_files/iTNC530/340490-01/en/533_188-20.pdf), PDF page 237, gives Q200/Q201/Q206/Q202/Q210/Q203/Q204/Q211 for G200. The published row points to page 334, which describes the G220 point pattern instead. Similar unrelated lists occur in the older cycle-200 and cycle-209 rows. This is more than a list cut short at a page break. Validate every B3 row against the definition of the named cycle, or remove an unverified row. Keep extraction within that cycle's definition and give a complete manual ID and page for each retained row. Remove the claim that these lists are reliable until this check is complete.

3. **Changes are assigned to an excluded control — `docs/research/heidenhain/differences-by-version.md:124`.** This section assigns software 280476 and cycles 209/247 plus M142/M143/M144 to TNC 410. Its own entries explicitly exclude TNC 410. Manual [34594022](https://content.heidenhain.de/doku/tnc_guide/pdf_files/TNC400/280476-xx/diniso/345_940-22.pdf), PDF pages 5-6, maps 280476/477 to TNC 426/430 and 286060/080 to TNC 410. The false assignment also reaches the `C names it: 410 280476-xx` rows in `cycles.md` and the cycle-247 value in the TNC 410 profile. Validate both the control and the version heading for every generated entry. Apply the exclusions in a shared manual before assigning a feature, and correct the derived tables. Also check entries under 81760x-01 that explicitly name 81760x-03 changes (`differences-by-version.md:388`).

Non-blocking note: `dialects.md:153` refers to the old `../picomax-heidenhain/review.md` path. The published review is now `picomax-55-review.md`.

The review worktree and branch remain in place to keep the local build cache.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

This PR is a draft again. The fixes for the review findings go onto this branch now. A re-check request follows after the push.

Reply to the review of head 7e377f8fb. The fixes are on head 5a1fddf15. The PR is a draft again while the fixes go on.

**1. Wrong profile thresholds**

- What was wrong: the TNC 320 threshold for cycle 205 Q208/Q395 was 77185x-05. Manual 1096959-20 PDF p9 ("New cycle functions of software 77185x-01") and p82 give 77185x-01. The `dialects.md` profile also had M140 false for all of TNC 426/430 280 472-477, but M140 arrives at 280 476 (340 135-22 PDF p6).
- How it was validated: each profile cell of `dialects.md` was derived again from B2, from the new B3 and from the corrected section C. Each row now has a "Sources" column with the manual ID and the PDF page.
- What changed: 77185x-01 in README finding 3, the B2 cycle 205 row, the `cycles.md` cycle 205 row, the profile `tnc320-77185x` and the "Result" paragraph of `dialects.md`. The profile `tnc426b` is now three profiles: `tnc426-472` (no cycle 205), `tnc426-474` (205-208 from 280 474, 318 179-24 PDF p11) and `tnc426-476` (M140, cycles 209 and 247, 340 135-22 PDF p6). TNC 320 340 551-01 to 34055x-06 now have `c205: q379`, because B3 shows Q379/Q253 from 340 551-01.
- Now marked unknown: TNC 310 and TNC 426 280 460-470 dwell (cycle 9 is not in their cycle lists), TNC 620 340 56x-01 `iso` (the sources disagree), TNC 320 34055x-03 `iso`, and TNC7 81762x-16 `c205` (no example block).

**2. Q lists with parameters of a different cycle**

- What was wrong: the old script searched for the bare cycle number and kept the longest list near any match. Some rows got the G220 pattern parameters, and some cycle 207 rows got cycle 209 parameters.
- How it was validated: the script was replaced. It now takes only the example block that starts with the cycle's own number and name (for example `N110 G200 DRILLING`), and it stops at the next NC block. A row is kept only when its list starts with Q200 and the block ends normally. The rows were spot-checked against the PDF pages: 53318820 p237 (G200: Q200/Q201/Q206/Q202/Q210/Q203/Q204/Q211), 53318820 p262 (G205, no Q208/Q395) and 1096959-20 p75 (cycle 203).
- What changed: section B3 of `differences.md` has 336 new rows. Each row has the full manual ID and the PDF page. The iTNC 34049x-01 cycle 200 row now cites 53318820 p237. The claim that the old lists are reliable is removed from the method note.
- Removed rows: three TNC 620 cycle 209 rows (340 56x-02, 340 56x-03, 73498x-01), because their lists stop after Q203 at a column break.
- Note: many cycle 203 example blocks print `Q211=0 ;DWELL TIME AT TOP`, but the parameter list of the same page names Q210. B3 shows the blocks as printed and states this misprint.

**3. Changes assigned to an excluded control**

- What was wrong: section C put the 280 476 list of the shared ISO manual 345 940-22 under the TNC 410. That manual maps 280 476/477 to the TNC 426/430 and 286 060/080 to the TNC 410 (PDF p5). It also marks cycles 205-209, 247, 19 (G80), 32 (G62), the SL II cycles, M128 and tilting as "not TNC 410" (PDF p6, p12, p17-19).
- How it was validated: the control and the version heading of each generated entry were checked. The only shared manual across two control sections is 345 940-22. A script then compared the software version that each bullet or "other" fragment names with its heading.
- What changed in `differences-by-version.md`: the TNC 410 section now has only a note. Under 81760x-01, two bullets that describe 81760x-03 were removed (the same entries stay under 81760x-03). These "other" fragments were removed: 77185x-01 (names -04), 77185x-05 (names -01), 81760x-01 (names -04), 81760x-05 (names -01), 34059x-04 and 34059x-08 (name other versions). One 34049x-06 bullet ended with the next list heading (34049x-07). It was removed, and its duplicate from 670 388-21 stays. A hand-checked bullet for 77185x-01 (Q208/Q395, 1096959-20 p9 and p82) was added.
- What changed in the derived tables: the "C names it: 410 280476-xx" entries are gone from `cycles.md` (cycles 209, 247, 262, 267 and TCH PROBE 440). The cycle 19, 32, 205-209 and 247 rows say "Not TNC 410" with the page. The TNC 410 profile now has `c200: base` (B3 30974025 p139), no cycle 205, no cycle 247, `tilt: none` and no M128. The B2 rows for M128, M140, cycles 19/32/200/205/207/209/247 and the 200-series row were corrected in the same way.

**4. Note: link to the Picomax review**

- `dialects.md` now links `picomax-55-review.md`.

No code changed. No gate step covers `docs/research/`.

Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking finding remains.

Earlier findings:

1. **Wrong capability profiles: fixed in `5a1fddf15`.** The TNC 320 threshold is now `77185x-01` in the profile, README, B2 and cycle table. Manual [1096959-20](https://content.heidenhain.de/doku/tnc_guide/pdf_files/TNC320/771851-01/zyklen/1096959-20.pdf), PDF pages 9 and 82, confirms Q208/Q395. The TNC 426/430 profiles now separate 280472, 280474 and 280476. Manual [31817924](https://content.heidenhain.de/doku/tnc_guide/pdf_files/TNC400/280474-xx/diniso/318_179-24.pdf), PDF page 11, confirms the 280474 cycle boundary. Manual [34013522](https://content.heidenhain.de/doku/tnc_guide/pdf_files/TNC400/280476-xx/bhb/340_135-22.pdf), PDF page 6, confirms M140, cycle 209 and cycle 247 at 280476. The table adds sources and marks several uncertain cells unknown.
2. **Q lists from other cycles: fixed in `5a1fddf15`.** B3 now has 336 rows with a manual ID and PDF page for each row. I checked all row formats and parameter groups. I also checked 20 rows against source pages across five manuals. These checks cover cycles 200, 203, 205, 207 and 209. The iTNC cycle 200 and 205 lists agree with [53318820](https://content.heidenhain.de/doku/tnc_guide/pdf_files/iTNC530/340490-01/en/533_188-20.pdf), PDF pages 237 and 262. The unrelated point-pattern parameters are gone. The method now states its limits. It removes three incomplete rows and explains the cycle 203 misprint. I did not check all 336 rows against the full manuals.
3. **Wrong control and version assignment: fixed in `5a1fddf15`.** Section C removes the TNC 410 280476 entries. The cycle table and TNC 410 profile apply the exclusions. The corrected mapping agrees with [34594022](https://content.heidenhain.de/doku/tnc_guide/pdf_files/TNC400/280476-xx/diniso/345_940-22.pdf), PDF pages 5–6 and 17–19. The 81760x-03 entries are removed from the 81760x-01 section. The other version fragments named in the author's reply are also corrected.
4. **Old Picomax link: fixed in `5a1fddf15`.** The link now points to `picomax-55-review.md`.

Local results:

- Checked the changes against current `upstream/main` rules at `5b52c5f8ca0a03e8b71af0453056b920b5d9e742`.
- Main is already an ancestor of this PR. Local trial merge `4a77499dd4d79ebeaf7cb8b7e189e91c42841de4` has the PR head as its first parent. Main is its second parent. Its tree equals the PR tree. There was no conflict.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed; no applicable test steps.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed; 0 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. The local gate tool built successfully.
- Product build, product tests, clippy, light lanes and heavy lanes: not run. This change adds only Markdown research notes. It changes no product code or test input.
- **Extra suites run:** none. No fixture, importer, post, operation, motion or catalog file changed.
- **Mutations:** not applicable. Posted G-code, geometry, stock simulation, gouge checks and collision checks do not change.
- **Goldens moved:** none. No UI change; screenshots are not required.
- Source files and review evidence stay in a temporary directory. No GitHub runner was used.

Requested before merge: none. The implementation work stays open under `Refs #4095`.

The review worktree and branch remain in place to keep the local build cache.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
